name: Claude Corps
funding_detail: Salary and benefits; see the official offer.
location: United States; existing US work authorization required.
timing: Rolling applications for the August 2027 cohort.
fit: A first role using AI inside a nonprofit; coding experience is not required.
requirements: Age 18+. No degree required. US authorization must not require employer sponsorship; student OPT does not qualify. Be willing to relocate; a remote placement is not guaranteed.

name: Anthropic Fellows: AI Safety & Security
funding_detail: Weekly stipend; amount and benefits vary by country.
location: Shared workspaces in Berkeley or London; confirm permitted work locations.
timing: Applications reviewed on a rolling basis.
fit: For technically prepared newcomers to AI research, rather than an introduction to programming.
requirements: Python fluency and full-time availability required. Strong technical background expected; confirm work authorization and location with the programme.

name: MATS Research Fellowship
funding_detail: Stipend, compute support, housing and travel support described by the programme.
location: Confirm location and visa arrangements for the next cohort.
timing: Winter 2027 applications are closed; future rounds not confirmed here.
fit: Build supervised research experience across AI safety, governance and related tracks.
requirements: Selection and preparation vary by research track. Review mentor requirements before applying.

name: AI Policy Fellowship
organization: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy
funding_detail: Stipend; additional support depends on track.
location: DC, London or remote, with a required initial event in Washington, DC.
fit: A supported transition into practical AI policy for applicants with relevant skills.
requirements: All fellows attend the initial two-week DC event. Work authorization differs by location; remote does not remove travel requirements.

name: GovAI Seasonal Fellowships
organization: Centre for the Governance of AI
funding_detail: Check funding on the specific cohort announcement.
location: London or Washington, DC, depending on programme.
timing: Winter 2027 research, applied and DC fellowship applications are closed.
fit: Research and applied tracks can suit different routes into AI governance.
requirements: Applicants range from early-career to experienced professionals. Choose a track that matches your skills; confirm location and work authorization.

name: Horizon Fellowship: Junior Track
funding_detail: Check compensation and support on the current cohort announcement.
location: United States; pre-existing work authorization generally required.
timing: Check the next application round on the official site.
fit: The think-tank junior track accepts applicants without work experience, including students finishing college.
requirements: Subject knowledge in AI, biotechnology or related areas is assessed. Other tracks require experience or graduate training. Visa exceptions are limited and track-specific.

name: Cambridge ERA:AI Fellowship
funding_detail: Confirm stipend and support for the specific cohort.
timing: Check the official site for the next round and its dates.
fit: A research route for strong project builders, including undergraduates and people changing fields.
requirements: Age 18+. Formal research experience is helpful but not required. Participation is in person; students or employed applicants need time away.

name: UNICEF Internship Programme
funding_detail: Monthly stipend; travel and visa support may depend on funding.
location: Offices worldwide; location and remote options depend on each vacancy.
timing: Vacancies are posted throughout the year; each has its own deadline.
fit: Practical humanitarian experience for current students and recent graduates.
requirements: Age 18+. Enrolled in a degree programme or graduated within two years. Language and other requirements depend on the vacancy.

name: Outreachy Internships
funding_detail: USD 7,000 stipend for the three-month internship.
location: International applications; local eligibility and availability rules apply.
timing: Check the current round: initial applications and contribution periods are separate.
fit: Mentored open-source work, including some design and documentation projects.
requirements: Age 18+. Intended for people facing underrepresentation or systemic barriers in technology. Student calendars, prior internships and full-time availability affect eligibility.

name: Google Summer of Code
funding_detail: Project stipend; check current rules and amounts.
location: Global online programme; country restrictions apply under current rules.
timing: Annual programme; check the official timeline for the next intake.
fit: Build a public coding portfolio with an experienced open-source mentor.
requirements: Designed for new open-source contributors. Coding and project-specific skills matter; confirm current age, residency and contributor rules.

name: LFX Mentorship
funding_detail: Funding and stipend terms depend on the project.
location: Project-specific; confirm location and participation terms.
timing: Browse project-specific application windows; not every project is recruiting.
fit: A way for first-time open-source contributors to build practical skills.
requirements: Required skills and eligibility differ by project. Choose a project before checking its funding, schedule and remote arrangements.

name: Climate Change: Learning for Action
funding_detail: Fee-based education; need-based scholarships available. Not a paid job.
location: Online; confirm live-session times for your location.
timing: Check the next cohort and full fees on the official site.
fit: Structured climate learning and career exploration for people entering the sector.
requirements: This is a learning programme, not employment. Assess total cost, time commitment and scholarship terms before enrolling.

name: Climatebase Fellowship
funding_detail: Fee-based career programme; financial aid may be available. Not paid employment.
location: Confirm format and time-zone expectations with the current cohort.
timing: Check current cohort availability and fees.
fit: Explore climate industries and build connections while planning a career transition.
requirements: This is professional development, not a job offer. Confirm total fees, aid and suitability for your experience.

name: Frontier AI Governance
funding_detail: Free course; not a paid fellowship or job.
timing: The source displays 18 October without a year; confirm the current intake.
fit: Explore policy and governance before applying for a specialised fellowship.
requirements: Some familiarity with AI capabilities and risks helps. Be ready for readings, writing and discussion.

name: Technical AI Safety
duration: About 6 weeks part-time or a short intensive
timing: Check the current schedule and application window.
fit: Map the AI safety field before choosing research projects or fellowships.
requirements: Basic understanding of LLM training and gradient descent expected. Designed for technical and research-oriented participants.
